body: What if your home wasn’t just a living space, but a fully calibrated energetic sanctuary? You’ve started your collection. You have the tools. But now, the question we hear most often is: “How do I use them all together?” For the first time ever, we are bringing you the masterclass you’ve been asking for. On Wednesday, February 25th at 6PM PST , join Heather Askinosie for a live Zoom experience designed to help you move beyond single-device use and into the art of Frequency Layering. Heather lives and breathes this practice, with over 20 generators running in her own home. She has spent years testing which frequencies harmonize, which ones amplify specific intentions, and how to "grid" a home for maximum impact. This is your invitation to stop guessing and start orchestrating your energetic environment with precision.
